context.p: You can fold or unfold the outside rearview mirror by pressing the button as shown in the following image:

step.cmd: To fold the outside rearview mirror,press the button (1).
To unfold it, press the button (1) again.

note.p: You can adjust the electric outside rearview mirrors even when the vehicle is in the OFF positions. To prevent unnecessary battery discharge, do not adjust the mirrors for longer than necessary while the engine is not running.
Do not fold an electric outside rearview mirror by hand. This action can cause motor failure.
